_source: CORE ELA Pacing Guide 5th Grade - Open Up EL Education, uploaded 8/31/26, transcribed by week (parsed from the guide's M | U | L labels and lesson titles, cross-checked against Appendix A's Grade 5 ELA bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md).
_note: Module = EL Education Module, Unit = the Unit within that Module (stored as a string; lesson numbers reset per Unit, as in Grades K/1/2/3/4). Unlike Grade 4, three weeks cross a Unit boundary within the same Module - week 3 (Unit 1 to Unit 2), week 13 (Unit 1 to Unit 2), and week 16 (Unit 2 to Unit 3) - each split into two segments per the standing rule; the other 33 weeks are single segments. This guide runs the full 36 weeks with no early finish, matching Grade 4. 'assessment' names any Unit Assessment / Performance Task falling within that segment's lessons - 'Mid-Unit'/'End of Unit'/'Part I/II' and colon detail are dropped, keeping only the base tag; a tag repeated across lessons in the same segment (e.g. weeks 16, 24, 26, 30 each print the same End-of-Unit-Assessment title on two consecutive lessons) is written once. Two confirmed guide typos, both resolved by lesson-number contiguity, body wins: week 8's final lesson is mislabeled 'M1 | U1 | L9' where every surrounding lesson that week and the title itself ('Performance Task: Gathering Evidence') place it in Unit 3 - transcribed as M1 U3 L9; week 13's third lesson is mislabeled 'M1 | U2 | L3' where the two lessons before it that same week are M2 U2 L1-2 and the title continues the same Reading-Literary-Texts sequence - transcribed as M2 U2 L3. Appendix A's own stored bullet for Grade 5 ELA LP4 carries a stray, lesson-less 'M1 U2' fragment - the same typo reproduced there, not a separate error. Confirmed against Appendix A's Grade 5 Open Up EL Education bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md: every CLOSED range agrees exactly - LP1 M1 U2 (1-6), LP2 M1 U3 (1-9), LP4 M2 U2 (1-11), LP5 M3 U1 (1-4), LP6 M3 U2 (1-10) - once Appendix A's own open-ended 'Lessons N - End of Unit N Assessment' phrasing is read as non-comparable, not as a range. Lesson accounting is contiguous from 1 with no gaps or duplicates across all twelve Module/Unit pairs (M1: 12, 16, 13 lessons; M2: 13, 13, 13; M3: 12, 15, 13; M4: 13, 9, 12), 154 lessons total.
